nodes.description: Address of the contract owner stored in BotProtected; gates privileged functions (list, delegate).
Address of the external Ferrum bot-protection contract that is low-level called by the checkBots modifier.
Uniswap V2 pair address computed deterministically in the constructor via pairFor(wETH, address(this)).
Public mapping holding token balances; mutated directly in transferFrom and list.
Public nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount; mutated in approve, transferFrom and constructor.
Total token supply, initialized to 155000000000000000000000000 and used in list allocation math.
UniswapV2Router02 instance used by list to add ETH liquidity.
Mainnet WETH address used for pair address computation.
Base constructor that assigns the botProtection address.
Modifier performing a low-level call to botProtection with selector 0x15274141 before executing the wrapped function body.
Token constructor: sets owner to msg.sender, computes uniPair and grants infinite allowances.
Payable public transfer that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
Payable public transferFrom guarded by the checkBots modifier; performs raw unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic.
Payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function performing arbitrary delegatecall to caller-supplied address a with calldata b.
Pure function deriving the Uniswap pair address from two tokens and hardcoded init code hash.
Owner-only payable function that sets balances, adds liquidity via uniRouter with a block.timestamp deadline, and airdrops to a list of recipients.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance checks and balance mutations.
Block timestamp used as liquidity deadline (block.timestamp + 600) in list.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary code in the token's storage context with the user-supplied address and calldata.
botProtection.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x15274141,...)) is an unchecked low-level external call performed inside the modifier.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath (pre-0.8 arithmetic).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath.
